stage0075_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ラー・カイラム$$ $$アムロ・レイ$$'s Quarters ～

stage0075_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「...Just what do you want with us?」

stage0075_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$クェス$$
「What's wrong, Captain?
　You're making such a scary face...」

stage0075_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「From the look of it,
　they don't seem to know a thing.」

stage0075_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So you think so too...」

stage0075_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$アムロ$$ was nearly assassinated.」

stage0075_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アムロ$$
「He resisted me, and by the time
　$$刹那$$ and the others arrived at the noise,
　he'd already killed himself.」

stage0075_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ブライト$$
「He was a maintenance man who came aboard
　from the Far East Branch, but his belongings
　and other things showed he was Neo Zeon.」

stage0075_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$クェス$$
「Wait, Captain!
　We don't know anything about that...!」

stage0075_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「Calm down, $$クェス$$.
　Captain $$アムロ$$ understands that much, too.」

stage0075_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Still, I suppose that's not enough to clear us...」

stage0075_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ブライト$$
「There's also the unit's internal security to
　think about. Until things are clear, I'll have to
　restrict your movements.」

stage0075_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't want to go that far.
　In the face of a crisis to the world, you fought
　together with us as $c.」

stage0075_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'll hear $$シャア$$'s side of this.
　Depending on what he says, you may have
　to go back to $$アクシズ$$.」

stage0075_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「So the ceasefire is over, then...」

stage0075_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I hope it doesn't come to that.」

stage0075_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$カツ$$
「Guess even the Red Comet can fall from grace...!」

stage0075_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Seriously!
　Sending an assassin into $c...!」

stage0075_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$リディ$$
「Sure, Captain $$アムロ$$ is the core of $c,
　but targeting a single pilot like that...」

stage0075_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$シャア$$'s fighting this whole war just to
　settle things with $$アムロ$$ personally...!」

stage0075_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$カツ$$
「I had a feeling before, but
　this incident made it clear!」

stage0075_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$カミーユ$$... What do you think?」

stage0075_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think it's true that $$シャア$$ wants to
　settle things with Captain $$アムロ$$.」

stage0075_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「But I don't think he'd go so far as to
　start a war over it.」

stage0075_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$カツ$$
「Are you taking his side, $$カミーユ$$?」

stage0075_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Take it easy.
　Getting emotional makes you no different
　from someone who wages war over feelings.」

stage0075_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I think the man called $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　is what Captain $$クワトロ$$, the man we knew,
　looks like once he's made up his mind.」

stage0075_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「So his true nature hasn't changed, then.」

stage0075_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah...
　So this war, too, is probably something he's
　seriously thought through for the world's future.」

stage0075_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Though I've no intention of endorsing his methods.」

stage0075_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If he sees settling things with Captain $$アムロ$$
　not as personal pride or stubbornness,
　but purely as strategy...」

stage0075_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「In his position as Neo Zeon's Supreme Commander,
　he'd be the one sending the assassin himself.」

stage0075_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「If that's the case, though he failed this time,
　Captain $$アムロ$$ won't stand a chance.」

stage0075_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But he wouldn't use a method like that.」

stage0075_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's right.
　That's both his weakness and what makes him human.」

stage0075_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「But the fact remains, $$アムロ$$
　nearly got killed!」

stage0075_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カツ$$
「$$シャア$$'s changed!
　I bet even that ceasefire was just a scheme
　to catch us off guard!」

stage0075_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Just because you can't trust the other side,
　if you stand on the same ground yourself,
　things will only get worse.」

stage0075_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Right now, what we need to do is
　accurately grasp the situation, and
　confirm what we ourselves should do.」

stage0075_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「$$ハサウェイ$$...
　I understand that you despise
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$ over what happened with $$クェス$$.」

stage0075_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$オードリー$$
「But you mustn't turn that into hatred
　and use it as strength for battle.」

stage0075_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Otherwise the war... the fighting will never end.」

stage0075_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...I'm sorry, Ms. $$オードリー$$...
　I guess I wasn't quite myself...」

stage0075_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$カツ$$
「...I admit I got emotional...
　But what else could I do...」

stage0075_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$オードリー$$
「It's all right, $$カツ$$.
　No one is perfect.」

stage0075_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$オードリー$$
「If you can listen to the people around you
　who set you right, you can change.」

stage0075_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I'll remember that, Ms. $$オードリー$$.」

stage0075_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Really.
　Calming down two people who were that worked up...」

stage0075_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you, $$タクヤ$$, $$ミコット$$.」

stage0075_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$リディ$$
「Not many people could do that.
　Those two were pretty worked up over their idol,
　Captain $$アムロ$$, being put in danger...」

stage0075_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$リディ$$
「Maybe you're the kind of person
　who's meant to lead others.」

stage0075_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$リディ$$
「I've seen plenty of people the world calls leaders.
　But they were greedy, pushy types, full of ego.」

stage0075_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$リディ$$
「But you're different.
　Your words just slip in and move people's hearts.」

stage0075_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$バナージ$$
（It's just like Ensign $$リディ$$ says...
　I'm the same, led into this fight by $$オードリー$$ myself...）

stage0075_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Thank you, Ensign $$リディ$$...」

stage0075_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$オードリー$$
（But I don't deserve words like that...）

stage0075_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$オードリー$$
（It must've been him who ordered
　$$アムロ・レイ$$'s assassination... I don't know why,
　but Neo Zeon is in turmoil right now...）

stage0075_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$オードリー$$
（And yet I'm not doing anything,
　just telling myself I'm fighting too, out here...）

stage0075_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$オードリー$$...
　No one person needs to carry it all alone.」

stage0075_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Looks like $$バナージ$$ was considerate enough
　to leave you alone for a bit.」

stage0075_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$オードリー$$
「I'm just glad you're safe, Captain.」

stage0075_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...War is a place that twists people...
　You end up hating people you don't hate,
　and having to kill those you don't want to...」

stage0075_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Are you defending the assassin?」

stage0075_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$オードリー$$
「Then is this an excuse for what you've done?」

stage0075_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$オードリー$$
「The Federation's White Meteor...
　To Zeon, that's nothing but a devil.」

stage0075_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...I suppose that's fair to say.
　But that was the role I was given back then.」

stage0075_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「You could call it responsibility instead.」

stage0075_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That's not something someone else tells you.
　It's something you decide for yourself.」

stage0075_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So, $$オードリー$$...
　When your time comes, decide your own
　responsibility for yourself.」

stage0075_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's been bothering me for a while.
　I feel like I know you from somewhere...」

stage0075_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But the person I knew wasn't you.
　It was her, fighting to the end at Solomon
　for her pride, the future she believed in, and you.」

stage0075_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$リディ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$!
　There's a unit closing in on our position!」

stage0075_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$リディ$$
「No... it appears to be Neo Zeon.」

stage0075_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「How's it going on your end, $$マリーダ$$!」

stage0075_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「For now, I've secured a route to the hangar.」

stage0075_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$クェス$$
「Sorry, $$ミコット$$.
　But you're going to be our hostage.」

stage0075_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Sorry for dragging you into this.
　But if you do as we say,
　we won't get rough with you.」

stage0075_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$ギュネイ$$, $$クェス$$...
　go on ahead to the hangar.」

stage0075_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$クェス$$
「Where are you going, $$マリーダ$$!?」

stage0075_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm going to meet her.
　That is my mission.」

stage0075_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$リディ$$
「...When I was a kid, I once heard
　a speech by the Zabi family...」

stage0075_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$リディ$$
「Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon...
　Such an eerie sight.」

stage0075_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$リディ$$
「Gihren Zabi... your uncle led the way,
　and thousands of people cried out as one.」

stage0075_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「What are you trying to say?」

stage0075_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$リディ$$
「...$$ミネバ$$ Zabi...
　The last of the Zabi bloodline...」

stage0075_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$リディ$$
「If I'd known that when we first met,
　I wonder what I'd have thought of you...」

stage0075_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$リディ$$
「Now that we've come this far,
　even $c can't catch up to us anymore,
　and we'll soon be in Federation territory.」

stage0075_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$リディ$$
「Our little escape is almost over.
　...But before that, will you tell me
　why you've been traveling with us?」

stage0075_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「...I too have a family I was born into.
　One that bears the shame of the $$一年戦争$$.」

stage0075_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「I cannot stay apart from politics.
　If I return to Neo Zeon, people will surely
　try to use me for their own ends.」

stage0075_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$リディ$$
「But $$ハマーン・カーン$$ and $$マリーダ・クルス$$
　knew you were with $c
　and left you alone anyway.」

stage0075_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「The Neo Zeon of today is $$シャア$$'s doing.
　With his skill, the Spacenoids can be
　united as one.」

stage0075_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Conversely, my existence would only
　give rise to needless opposition.」

stage0075_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$リディ$$
「So that's why you left Neo Zeon?」

stage0075_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「At the same time, if my name still means
　something, I thought I might stop the war...」

stage0075_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「But that was arrogant of me.
　Before $$シャア$$, I learned how small
　my presence... the Zabi name, truly is.」

stage0075_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$リディ$$
「If that's true, isn't it strange?
　Today, $$ハマーン$$ seemed to come for you.」

stage0075_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「There must be a movement within Neo Zeon
　to make me their figurehead.」

stage0075_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$リディ$$
「A rift within Neo Zeon...?
　Is $$ハマーン$$ going to turn on $$シャア$$?」

stage0075_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「I don't think that's it.
　I think she wanted to protect me before
　someone else could use me.」

stage0075_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$リディ$$
「Can you trust the Iron Lady?」

stage0075_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$リディ$$
「...All right.
　If that's what you say, I've nothing more to add.」

stage0075_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「If I'm to become their figurehead,
　then my actions might stop the war too.」

stage0075_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$リディ$$
「Is that your resolve, worth throwing
　your life away for?」

stage0075_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Let's go, Ensign $$リディ$$.
　We... the world has little time left.」

stage0075_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$リディ$$
（My time with you...
　a pilot's time with a girl who has
　nowhere to go... it's nearly gone too...）

stage0075_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$リディ$$
（But, $$オードリー$$...
　you, at least, I'll...）

stage0075_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Since pursuit isn't an option,
　there's nothing to do but watch and wait
　where Ensign $$リディ$$ and $$オードリー$$ are concerned.」

stage0075_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Echoes was tracking information on
　$$ミネバ$$ Zabi too, but I never imagined
　she'd be right here with us...」

stage0075_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$エマ$$
「Even $$バナージ$$ didn't know.
　It couldn't be helped.」

stage0075_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$オードリー$$... can she really stop the war?」

stage0075_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No one person has the power to do that.」

stage0075_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Then why did you let Ensign $$リディ$$
　go, Captain!?」

stage0075_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's what she chose to do herself.
　There's no reason to stop her.」

stage0075_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アムロ$$
（She fought alongside us in $c...
　Wanting to believe in those days we
　shared is far too romantic of me...）

stage0075_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「$$ミネバ$$ Zabi's fine as she is, but
　the problem is Unicorn and $$バナージ$$.」

stage0075_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Neo Zeon... or rather, $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　still seems to be after Laplace's Box.」

stage0075_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「The coordinates the Laplace Program
　pointed to... they'll take him to Dakar.」

stage0075_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「But Dakar is right in the middle
　of Federation territory.」

stage0075_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$フロンタル$$ is obsessed with finding the Box.
　He'll remove any obstacle by force.」

stage0075_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But we're battered all over.
　Today's unexpected fighting cost us too.」

stage0075_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Let's have the Federation deploy troops
　to Dakar, and get there ourselves fast.」

stage0075_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$バナージ$$... he'll be all right, right?」

stage0075_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Until they get their hands on Laplace's Box,
　$$バナージ$$'s safety is guaranteed.」

stage0075_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「But now that the agreement's broken,
　we'll be fighting Neo Zeon again...」

stage0075_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$, $$ハマーン$$, $$フロンタル$$... and $$ミネバ$$...）

stage0075_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Where is Neo Zeon trying to go...）

stage0075_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アムロ$$
「...Since pursuit isn't an option,
　there's nothing to do but watch and wait
　where Ensign $$リディ$$ and $$オードリー$$ are concerned.」

stage0075_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「Echoes was tracking information on
　$$ミネバ$$ Zabi too, but who'd have thought
　she'd be right here with us...」

stage0075_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$エマ$$
「Even $$バナージ$$ didn't know.
　It couldn't be helped.」

stage0075_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「$$オードリー$$... can she really stop the war?」

stage0075_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$アムロ$$
「No one person has the power to do that.」

stage0075_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Then why did you let Ensign $$リディ$$
　go, Captain!?」

stage0075_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アムロ$$
「It's what she chose to do herself.
　There's no reason to stop her.」

stage0075_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アムロ$$
（She fought alongside us in $c...
　Wanting to believe in those days we
　shared is far too romantic of me...）

stage0075_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「$$ミネバ$$ Zabi's fine as she is, but
　the problem is Unicorn and $$バナージ$$.」

stage0075_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Neo Zeon... or rather, $$フル・フロンタル$$,
　still seems to be after Laplace's Box.」

stage0075_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:

「The coordinates the Laplace Program
　pointed to... they'll take him to Dakar.」

stage0075_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「But Dakar is right in the middle
　of Federation territory.」

stage0075_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$アムロ$$

　He'll remove any obstacle by force.」

stage0075_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:

stage0075_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アムロ$$

stage0075_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$タクヤ$$

stage0075_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$カミーユ$$

　$$バナージ$$'s safety is guaranteed.」

stage0075_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$コンロイ$$
「But now that the agreement's broken,
　I guess we'll be fighting Neo Zeon again...」

stage0075_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$アムロ$$
（$$シャア$$, $$ハマーン$$, $$フロンタル$$... and $$ミネバ$$...）

stage0075_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（Where is Neo Zeon trying to go...）

stage0075_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「What's wrong? You look down.」

stage0075_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「...Can I really bring $$クェス$$ back...?」

stage0075_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「No matter how much I call out to $$クェス$$,
　my words don't seem to reach her...」

stage0075_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「You should ask her that yourself.」

stage0075_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「About your inquiry,
　when Master $$ハサウェイ$$ tried to persuade
　Master $$クェス$$, a Z-Chip was born.」

stage0075_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　It's solid proof her heart was moved.」

stage0075_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「There you go, $$ハサウェイ$$.
　Don't give up.」

stage0075_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Thank you, Mr. $$カミーユ$$.」

stage0075_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, when Master $$カミーユ$$ and
　Master $$ギュネイ$$ fought, a Z-Chip was born too.」

stage0075_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Combined with Master $$クェス$$'s, that's 100Z...
　I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0075_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I see...
　Her too, huh...」

stage0075_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Maybe someday, a day will come when
　he and I can understand each other too.」

stage0075_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How unusual.
　For Master $$ミヒロ$$ to come all the way here.」

stage0075_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「I just didn't want to see everyone
　for a bit...」

stage0075_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is about Master $$リディ$$, isn't it.」

stage0075_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「...But the Ensign has $$オードリー$$...」

stage0075_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please cheer up, Master $$ミヒロ$$!
　If you're like this, it'll be a problem
　when Master $$リディ$$ comes back!」

stage0075_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Besides, Master $$オードリー$$ already has
　Master $$バナージ$$. Master $$リディ$$ was playing
　the knight, but he could end up a clown.」

stage0075_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Maybe so.
　But the Ensign's such a soft touch, and jumps
　to conclusions, so that role might suit him.」

stage0075_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, you're sounding like yourself again!
　Now, the finishing magic words!」

stage0075_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all today too!」

stage0075_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for saying it with me.」

stage0075_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$...
　You're a lot kinder than everyone's
　rumors made you out to be.」

stage0075_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I make an exception for Master $$ミヒロ$$.」

stage0075_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Short in height, plump all over...
　Don't you think we're alike?」
